name: origins-of-life-vent
title: Origins-of-life vent campaign
lead:
The origin of cells, treated not as a single spark but as a staged sequence of nonequilibrium
transitions at an alkaline hydrothermal vent — each one a falsifiable step a simulation can pass or
fail. The guiding hypothesis is the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of life: that the vent–ocean
interface hands a nascent cell its first free-energy source (a natural proton gradient across thin
mineral walls), its first reduced carbon (H2-driven CO2 reduction), and a place to concentrate and
enclose that chemistry — before the cell evolves its own membranes, pumps and genes. The campaign
builds that vent from real geochemistry upward (serpentinization, reactive transport, H2-driven
carbon fixation, self-amplifying networks) and runs the classical favorable and the 2026 unfavorable
scenarios head to head rather than assuming either. Each stage is a coupled Vivarium composite of
genuine simulators (PHREEQC, FiPy, eQuilibrator, libRoadRunner) under explicit conservation contracts.
The first three stages — through reduced-carbon protometabolism — are built, run, and accepted; the
remaining stages toward a compartmentalized, bioenergetically autonomous protocell are designed and
waiting to run.

at_a_glance.role: The vent a cell would form in — validated geochemical/spatial testbed (no origin claim yet)
The cell's first carbon — H2-driven CO2 reduction; reproduce lab benchmarks; map the flux region
The first metabolism — reaction-network persistence and autocatalysis under flow
Becoming an individual — concentration/retention crosses persistence thresholds (milestone end)
The first boundary — amphiphile compartments give retention without isolation
Owning its energy — selection internalizes the vent's proton-gradient bioenergetics
The first heredity — competing inheritance modules; heredity must earn its keep
Before LUCA — population-level emergence vs single-lineage reconstruction
Leaving home — the minimum innovation set for an autonomous cell off-gradient
Adversarial control: the gates must reject generic non-vent chemistry

question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, or heredity by assumption?
hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.

executive.what_is_this: A staged, falsifiable Vivarium campaign testing the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of cells — treating a cellular origin as coupled transitions from geochemistry to bioenergetic autonomy, grounded in serpentinization-driven alkaline hydrothermal vents, with explicit competing scenarios.
executive.verdict: In progress — the pre-genetic milestone is three-for-three. og-00 (geochemical/spatial testbed), og-01 (geology → reduced carbon, favorable vs. Tutolo-2026 arms) and og-02 (reduced carbon → protometabolism) are built on real simulators, run, and accepted against pre-stated gates with conservation held to machine precision. og-03 (dilution → localized individuals) is next; og-04–og-08 and the adversarial control are designed but not yet run.
executive.verdict_detail: 10 member studies (Campaigns 0–VIII + an adversarial control) wired into a DAG. Stages 0–2 are complete — each runs a coupled Vivarium composite of real tools (PHREEQC + FiPy; eQuilibrator + FiPy; libRoadRunner) and passes its conservation and acceptance behavior tests. The remaining stages open at Design with a contract (ports + conservation invariants) and behavior tests derived from the acceptance gates and discriminating experiments.
decisions_resolved: Baseline parameterization: run BOTH arms — classical favorable (Russell/Lane/Sojo) and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment (Tutolo/Jackson) — so the campaign adjudicates rather than assumes. Implemented in og-01.

Primary geochemistry engine: real PHREEQC (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat), which fields the Lost City pH endmember once peridotite (not dunite) is reacted. Reaktoro was conda-only and off the uv path.
Build order: geochemistry + transport first (og-00/og-01), then the reaction network (og-02) — not a thin end-to-end skeleton. This put a real composite in the workbench at stage 0.

decisions_needed.question: Confirm the first-publication milestone stays og-00 → og-03 (pre-genetic: a precipitating interface that retains a persistent protometabolic carbon flux), or extend to og-04 (protocells)?
decisions_needed.context: Extending to og-04 adds membrane biophysics and roughly one more module before a publishable result. og-00 → og-02 are already accepted, so og-03 is the one remaining stage for the current scope.

decisions_needed.question: Heredity strategy for og-06: which modules to prioritize (RNA-world, peptide-first, compositional, mineral-templating)?
decisions_needed.context: og-06 is the weakest link and a deliberate branch point; the choice sets what the late campaign compares.

scientific_argument.main_claim: Cells could have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents — the vent–ocean interface supplies, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, compartmentation and bioenergetic internalization a protocell needs, and each step is an independently falsifiable nonequilibrium transition a Vivarium simulation can pass or fail, so simulations adjudicate among scenarios rather than illustrate one story.
evidence_for: H2-dependent mineral-catalyzed CO2 fixation (Preiner, Varma, Huber)
pH-gradient-driven CO2 reduction with isotope controls (Hudson, Altair)
thermophoretic concentration in pores (Baaske, Mast & Braun)
evidence_against: in-situ pH/sulfur/longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume (Tutolo 2026; Jackson 2016)
no validated vent pathway spans to open-ended heredity (Module J)
lab yields are not Hadean environmental concentrations
caveats: Stages 0–2 are complete and accepted; stages 3–8 and the adversarial control are designed but not yet run. Every quantitative anchor is laboratory/field provenance, not a Hadean environmental concentration.

key_claims.claim: Alkaline hydrothermal vents sustain a natural proton gradient across thin inorganic (Fe/Ni-sulfide) walls — a geologically free energy source a nascent cell could tap before evolving its own membrane and pumps.
Serpentinization of olivine delivers a sustained supply of H2, the reducing power that drives prebiotic chemistry at the vent.
That H2 reduces CO2 to organic carbon on native-metal and mineral catalysts without enzymes, reproducing the acetyl-CoA–like chemistry thought ancestral to life.
Nonenzymatic reaction networks (reductive-TCA fragments) can persist and self-amplify under continuous vent flow, a precursor to metabolism.
Thermal gradients in vent pores concentrate molecules by thermophoresis — a route to localized, individual-like accumulations against dilution.
Fatty-acid vesicles can assemble and persist under vent-like temperature and pH, giving the chemistry a compartment.
The classical favorable picture is contested — in-situ pH, sulfide availability and vent longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume, so each step is run against that challenge.

studies.name: og-00-vent-reactor-baseline
studies.title: Vent reactor baseline (Campaign 0)
studies.question: Can a Lost City–like, serpentinization-fed vent–ocean interface reproduce observed fluid mixing, heat transport, mineral precipitation and H2/alkalinity delivery under field-constrained conditions — with no origin-of-life claim?

resolved_uncertainties: The Lost City high-pH endmember is the peridotite Ca-OH buffer (not the olivine brucite buffer).
remaining_uncertainties: Sensitivity to the olivine/pyroxene ratio and to seawater-mixing dilution of the endmember.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Sweep pyroxene_fraction and mixing dilution to bound the pH endmember.

findings.statement: Outlet settles at 59.2 °C and pH 9.46 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).
findings.explanation: Real PHREEQC peridotite serpentinization (Ca-OH endmember) + FiPy transport; pH is a genuine speciation result, not tuned.

findings.statement: Serpentinization delivers a sustained H2 reducing-power flux (min 2.2e-4 mol/s over the back half of the run).
PHREEQC charge balance and FiPy FVM spatial-flux divergence are conserved to machine epsilon (<1e-6 and ~5e-16).
The Lost City pH endmember required reacting PERIDOTITE (olivine+pyroxene), not dunite — Ca released once Mg is consumed buffers the fluid to pH ~9.5.
findings.explanation: Olivine-only buffers at ~7.8 (brucite); adding diopside gives the Ca-OH endmember that reproduces field pH.
findings.next_action: Test sensitivity to the olivine/pyroxene ratio.

studies.claim: A real PHREEQC + FiPy serpentinization reactor settles into the Lost City window (T 59 °C, pH 9.46) with sustained H2 and exact mass/charge/spatial-flux conservation.

biological_validation.basis: No origin-of-life claim at this stage — this is a geochemical/spatial testbed only.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real speciation reproduces the field T/pH window AND reveals the peridotite Ca-OH endmember requirement — a mechanistic gain over the tuned box.

derived.insight: Outlet settles at 59.2 °C and pH 9.46 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).

studies.name: og-01-geology-to-reduced-carbon
studies.title: Geology to reduced carbon (Campaign I)
studies.question: Which combinations of T, pH, pressure, H2, CO2 and mineralogy generate sustained net organic-carbon flux across the interface — reproducing Hudson/Preiner/Altair regimes before any extrapolation?

resolved_uncertainties: A viable favorable regime exists; formate strictly requires the pH gradient + H2 + catalyst.
remaining_uncertainties: The gradient_efficiency threshold between the favorable and Tutolo-collapse regimes.

findings.statement: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

evidence.observed: formate=200 mM, acetate=100 µM, pyruvate=10 µM

findings.explanation: Real eQuilibrator ΔG'-gated, lab-calibrated mineral kinetics over the pH gradient.

findings.statement: Formate is present with the pH-gradient proton-motive force and collapses to <1 mM in every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst).
The Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm collapses the usable proton-motive gradient (pmf 427 → 43 mV), the discriminating test the campaign must survive.

evidence.observed: favorable pmf 427 mV vs Tutolo 43 mV

findings.explanation: Real FiPy Nernst-Planck electrodiffusion with a gradient_efficiency knob (1.0 favorable, 0.1 Tutolo).
findings.next_action: Sweep gradient_efficiency to bound the viable-fixation threshold.

findings.statement: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' is logged every step and makes feasibility explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' ≥ 0 — genuine product inhibition).

Carbon fixation SPENDS the proton gradient — a conserved proton budget (≈2 H⁺ per carbon) draws the loaded pmf down ~40% below the open-circuit 427 mV under load, then relaxes as products saturate. The gradient does work and is consumed, not merely correlated with reduction.

evidence.observed: pmf open-circuit 427 mV sags to ~250 mV (charge 0.60) at peak fixation, recovers to 427 mV

findings.explanation: A ProtonBudgetProcess integrates reservoir = supply − protons_per_carbon·carbon_flux − leak·reservoir; fixation reads the loaded pmf = pmf_open·(reservoir/capacity), closing the respiratory-control feedback.
findings.next_action: Sweep protons_per_carbon + supply_rate to bound where back-pressure starves fixation.

studies.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S reproduces the Preiner/Hudson lab yields and net organic-carbon flux in a bounded favorable regime; the Tutolo-2026 arm shows the usable proton-motive gradient collapses at in-situ T/P, zeroing the flux.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Preiner/Hudson organic-carbon benchmarks with the controls behaving correctly.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real thermodynamics (eQuilibrator) + electrochemistry (FiPy NPP) explain both the favorable regime and the Tutolo collapse.

derived.insight: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

simulations.name: Geology to reduced carbon (Campaign I) — favorable

studies.name: og-02-reduced-carbon-to-protometabolism
studies.title: Reduced carbon to protometabolism (Campaign II)
studies.question: Under continuous feed and washout, do reaction subnetworks become self-reinforcing — persistent cycles, flux amplification, product reuse, autocatalytic motifs — without imposed product accumulation?

resolved_uncertainties: A curated rTCA-fragment network under flow sustains throughput AND an autocatalytic motif.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether an acetyl-CoA-pathway arm cross-feeds or competes with the rTCA core.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Add the acetyl-CoA-pathway fragments as a parallel arm and test cross-feeding.

findings.statement: The rTCA-fragment network sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput (~9e-4 mol/s) under continuous feed + washout, with no imposed product accumulation.
findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner SBML CSTR — throughput is a steady balance of production and washout.

findings.statement: An autocatalytic motif emerges — OAA self-amplifies ~60× (gain ~3 steady, ~29 peak) via the lumped reductive-TCA turn; a no-CO2 control collapses it.
findings.explanation: The reductive-TCA turn OAA+2CO2->2OAA+acetate doubles its own entry molecule per turn — genuine autocatalysis, not an imposed assumption.
findings.next_action: Add an acetyl-CoA-pathway parallel arm and test cross-feeding.

findings.statement: Products form ONE connected reaction network (networkx connectivity), not disconnected one-offs.

studies.claim: A curated rTCA-fragment network under continuous feed + washout sustains nonzero carbon throughput, exhibits an autocatalytic motif (OAA self-amplification, gain ~3), and forms a single connected reaction network — metabolism-like behavior emerging without imposed product accumulation.

biological_validation.basis: Emergent sustained throughput + autocatalysis + connectivity, with a no-CO2 control collapsing them.

explanatory_gain.basis: The genuine libRoadRunner ODE network shows WHY autocatalysis arises (the reductive-TCA turn doubles OAA).

derived.insight: The rTCA-fragment network sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput (~9e-4 mol/s) under continuous feed + washout, with no imposed product accumulation.

studies.name: og-03-dilution-to-localized-individuals
studies.title: Dilution to localized individuals (Campaign III)
studies.question: When do retention time and concentration cross the thresholds for network persistence, as pore morphology evolves via precipitation/dissolution?

resolved_uncertainties: A geometric threshold exists — favorable pores concentrate >10^8-fold while open/short pores wash through.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the og-02 autocatalytic network actually persists in the concentrated pocket vs well-mixed bulk.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Couple the og-02 rTCA network into the trapped pocket; map the retention-time persistence threshold.

findings.statement: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) reproduces Baaske-2007 extreme accumulation — ~10^8-fold enrichment (accumulation Péclet 18.4) — from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon.
findings.explanation: ThermophoreticTrapProcess solves the steady accumulation column; enrichment = exp(beta·L) with beta from Soret × convection × confinement.

findings.statement: A localized individual forms only above a geometric threshold — an open pore (porosity→1) washes the feed through (enrichment ~1) and a 10× shorter pore enriches >100× less, mapping the washout region against the accumulation region.

evidence.observed: open-pore enrichment ~1; short pore >100x less than favorable

findings.explanation: Enrichment is exponential in pore length and vanishes with confinement — the dilution/localization boundary the campaign sought.
findings.next_action: Couple the og-02 network into the concentrated pocket to test in-pore persistence (network-persists-in-pore).

studies.claim: A real FiPy thermal trap (thermophoresis + convection) concentrates a dilute vent feed >10^8-fold in a favorable pore (Baaske 2007), and the concentration collapses to ~1 in an open pore — the geometric threshold at which a localized "individual" forms.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Baaske-2007 >10^8-fold accumulation benchmark with controls collapsing to ~1.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real transport (thermophoresis + convection) explains both the extreme enrichment and the geometry threshold for localization.

derived.insight: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) reproduces Baaske-2007 extreme accumulation — ~10^8-fold enrichment (accumulation Péclet 18.4) — from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon.

studies.name: og-04-mineral-compartments-to-protocells
studies.title: Mineral compartments to protocells (Campaign IV)
studies.question: Do mixed-amphiphile organic boundaries enhance persistence without cutting the system off from geochemical energy?

resolved_uncertainties: A non-empty individuality-without-isolation region exists — mixed amphiphiles form selectively-permeable vesicles at vent conditions.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether enclosing the og-02 network in the vesicle actually improves its persistence over the open pore.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Enclose the og-02 rTCA network in the vesicle; compare in-compartment vs well-mixed persistence.

findings.statement: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

evidence.observed: mixed viable ~8000; single-fatty-acid viable 0 at 0.35 M salt

findings.explanation: ProtocellAssemblyProcess broadens the pH window + salt/divalent tolerance with the co-surfactant fraction (coarse-grained, Jordan-calibrated).

findings.statement: The viable compartments retain internal chemistry (retention 0.91) while staying permeable to the external gradient (access 1.0) — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region (product ≈ 0.90), the key requirement for a protocell that does not cut itself off from geochemical energy.
findings.explanation: Selective permeability — low effective permeability to large/charged internal metabolites, higher to small external resources.
findings.next_action: Couple the og-02 network inside the vesicle to test whether the boundary improves network persistence vs the open pore.

studies.claim: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles across the alkaline / seawater-salt window where single fatty acids fail (Jordan 2019), and those compartments retain internal chemistry while staying permeable to the gradient — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Jordan-2019 mixed-amphiphile window broadening (mixed forms vesicles at salt where single fatty acids fail).

explanatory_gain.basis: Physical chemistry (window + selective permeability) explains both vesicle formation and the retention-without-isolation tradeoff.

derived.insight: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

studies.title: Environmental to internal bioenergetics (Campaign V)
studies.question: Can selection move from externally imposed gradients toward internally maintained electrochemical states (catalytic ion transport then pumping)?

studies.name: og-06-chemistry-to-heredity
studies.title: Chemistry to heredity (Campaign VI)
studies.question: Does inherited state improve persistence/throughput — comparing RNA-like, peptide-assisted, compositional and hybrid heredity — rather than template replication in isolation? (Do NOT presume RNA.)

studies.name: og-07-ecology-before-luca
studies.title: Ecology before LUCA (Campaign VII)
studies.question: In connected pore networks with cross-feeding, parasitism, cooperation and horizontal exchange, what emergent capabilities arise — compared to ancestral reconstructions, without assuming LUCA is primitive?

studies.name: og-08-escape-from-the-vent
studies.title: Escape from the vent (Campaign VIII)
studies.question: What is the minimum set of innovations required for autonomous persistence away from the geological reactor, as environmental support is relaxed?

studies.name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium
studies.title: Adversarial: generic nonequilibrium control
studies.question: Does a generic nonequilibrium chemical system with no vent-specific features (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration) pass the vent-specific gates? It SHOULD NOT.
